mapper.sql: c.del_flag = '0' and (#{admin}=true or c.consultant_id = #{consultantId}) and c.customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: select concat('customer:', c.customer_id) id, c.customer_name name, c.customer_label status, case when length(c.link_mobile) >= 7 then concat(left(c.link_mobile,3),'****',right(c.link_mobile,4)) else null end phoneMasked, c.customer_goods needs, c.acquisition_channel source, c.return_visit_remark note, (select date_format(max(e.occurred_at),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') from app_crm_event e where e.customer_id=c.customer_id and e.kind='followup') lastFollowupAt from app_customer c where order by c.customer_id

select concat('customer:', c.customer_id) id, c.customer_name name, c.customer_label status, c.link_mobile phone, c.sex, date_format(c.birthday,'%Y-%m-%d') birthday, c.age, c.live_address address, date_format(date_sub(c.sign_time, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') registeredAt, c.customer_goods needs, c.return_visit_remark note, date_format(date_sub(c.update_time, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') updatedAt, date_format(date_sub(c.return_visit_first, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') firstAt, date_format(date_sub(c.return_visit_second, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') secondAt, date_format(date_sub(c.return_visit_last, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') lastAt, c.link1_name name1, c.link1_relation relation1, c.link1_mobile phone1, c.link2_name name2, c.link2_relation relation2, c.link2_mobile phone2 from app_customer c where
mapper.sql: join app_customer_feishu_source s on binary s.source_table_id = binary p.source_table_id and binary s.source_record_id = binary p.feishu_record_id and s.customer_id=p.canonical_id and s.match_status in ('matched','created') join app_customer c on c.customer_id=s.customer_id where and p.canonical_table='app_customer' and p.canonical_status='linked'
mapper.select: select concat('customer:', c.customer_id) customerId, 'travel' businessLine, p.fs_fldqgctoqi source, p.fs_fldgo90joi status, p.fs_fldlivquuw needs, p.fs_fldrbddvel note, date_format(date_sub(p.fs_flds8m5nxa, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') updatedAt, null name1, null relation1, null phone1, null name2, null relation2, null phone2, null firstAt, null secondAt, null lastAt from app_travel_customer_profile p and binary s.source_table_id=binary 'tblXVuYCto8OOmAz' and s.business_line='travel' union all select concat('customer:', c.customer_id), 'eldercare', p.fs_fldzttzbcr, p.fs_fldjdf8dyq, p.fs_fldyh1qjlb, p.fs_fldwjfcdov, date_format(date_sub(p.fs_fld0mg0zba, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z'), p.fs_fldkhlyxv9, p.fs_fldwlrdj5r, p.fs_fldj8jvvqz, p.fs_fld5cspahu, p.fs_fldy0igasd, p.fs_fld1v5kx5e, date_format(date_sub(p.fs_fldcmilfhy, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z'), date_format(date_sub(p.fs_fld6je1obi, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z'), date_format(date_sub(p.fs_fldpzjxxhr, interval 8 hour),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') from app_eldercare_customer_profile p and binary s.source_table_id=binary 'tblHDwb0OdfcH1Ib' and s.business_line='eldercare'

select t.task_id id, concat('customer:',t.customer_id) customerId, t.title, t.status, t.version, date_format(t.due_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') dueAt, date_format(t.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') updatedAt from app_crm_task t join app_customer c on c.customer_id=t.customer_id where and t.status='pending' order by t.due_at, t.task_id

select n.opportunity_id id, concat('customer:',n.customer_id) customerId, n.title, n.business_line businessLine, n.stage, n.version, date_format(n.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') updatedAt from app_crm_opportunity n join app_customer c on c.customer_id=n.customer_id where order by n.updated_at desc, n.opportunity_id

select cast(e.event_id as char) id, e.kind, e.content, e.method, e.actor_name actorName, date_format(e.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') occurredAt, date_format(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') createdAt from app_crm_event e join app_customer c on c.customer_id=e.customer_id where and e.event_id < #{before} order by e.event_id desc limit 51

select distinct concat('order:',o.order_id) id, 'travel' businessLine, coalesce(o.feishu_order_no,o.order_no) code, o.travel_base_name title, date_format(o.check_in_date,'%Y-%m-%d') occurredOn, cast(round(coalesce(o.pay_money,o.money_payable)*100) as signed) amountCents, case o.travel_status when '0' then '待确认' when '1' then '已确认' when '2' then '已取消' when '3' then '已入住' when '4' then '已离店' when '5' then '已结算' when '6' then '退款中' when '7' then '已退款' else o.status end status, case when exists (select 1 from app_feishu_business_relation bad where binary bad.source_table_id=binary 'tblZWWWFyzY1hAyb' and binary bad.source_record_id=binary o.feishu_record_id and binary bad.source_field_id=binary 'fldioLyM1q' and (bad.relation_status!='resolved' or bad.target_business_id is null or bad.target_business_table!='app_customer')) then 'unresolved' when (select count(distinct r2.target_business_id) from app_feishu_business_relation r2 where binary r2.source_table_id=binary 'tblZWWWFyzY1hAyb' and binary r2.source_record_id=binary o.feishu_record_id and binary r2.source_field_id=binary 'fldioLyM1q' and r2.relation_status='resolved' and r2.target_business_table='app_customer') > 1 then 'shared' else 'single' end allocation, case when o.travel_status in ('2','6','7') then 1 else 0 end excluded from app_goods_order o join app_feishu_business_relation r on binary r.source_record_id=binary o.feishu_record_id and binary r.source_table_id=binary 'tblZWWWFyzY1hAyb' and binary r.source_field_id=binary 'fldioLyM1q' and r.target_business_table='app_customer' and r.relation_status='resolved' join app_customer c on c.customer_id=r.target_business_id join app_customer_feishu_source s on s.customer_id=c.customer_id and s.business_line='travel' and s.match_status in ('matched','created') and binary s.source_table_id=binary r.target_source_table_id and binary s.source_record_id=binary r.target_source_record_id join app_travel_customer_profile p on p.canonical_id=c.customer_id and p.canonical_table='app_customer' and p.canonical_status='linked' and binary p.source_table_id=binary s.source_table_id and binary p.feishu_record_id=binary s.source_record_id where and order by id limit 2001

select distinct concat('income:',i.income_id) id, 'eldercare' businessLine, i.income_no code, i.product_name title, date_format(i.trade_date,'%Y-%m-%d') occurredOn, cast(round(i.purchase_amount*100) as signed) amountCents, null status, case when links.unresolved > 0 or (i.customer_id is not null and links.customerCount > 0 and not exists ( select 1 from app_feishu_business_relation directLink where binary directLink.source_table_id=binary 'tblA33x9gGWM1b51' and binary directLink.source_record_id=binary links.source_record_id and binary directLink.source_field_id=binary 'fldL0xSls8' and directLink.relation_status='resolved' and directLink.target_business_table='app_customer' and directLink.target_business_id=i.customer_id )) then 'unresolved' when links.customerCount > 1 then 'shared' else 'single' end allocation, 0 excluded from app_customer_income i left join ( select source_record_id, count(distinct target_business_id) customerCount, sum(case when relation_status='resolved' and target_business_table='app_customer' and target_business_id is not null then 0 else 1 end) unresolved from app_feishu_business_relation where binary source_table_id=binary 'tblA33x9gGWM1b51' and binary source_field_id=binary 'fldL0xSls8' group by source_record_id ) links on binary i.income_no=binary concat('FS-',links.source_record_id) join app_customer c on c.customer_id=#{customerId} where and (i.customer_id=c.customer_id or exists (select 1 from app_feishu_business_relation r where binary i.income_no=binary concat('FS-',r.source_record_id) and binary r.source_table_id=binary 'tblA33x9gGWM1b51' and binary r.source_field_id=binary 'fldL0xSls8' and r.target_business_table='app_customer' and r.target_business_id=c.customer_id and r.relation_status='resolved')) and (#{admin}=true or i.consultant_id=#{consultantId} or (i.consultant_id is null and exists ( select 1 from app_feishu_business_relation r where binary i.income_no=binary concat('FS-',r.source_record_id) and binary r.source_table_id=binary 'tblA33x9gGWM1b51' and binary r.source_field_id=binary 'fld26vaZVW' group by r.source_record_id having count(distinct r.target_business_id) > 1 and max(case when r.target_business_id=#{consultantId} then 1 else 0 end)=1 and sum(case when r.relation_status='resolved' and r.target_business_table='app_consultant' and r.target_business_id is not null then 0 else 1 end)=0 ))) order by id limit 2001
